Indian Army Chief Visits Nepal, Honored by President

Indian Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth visited Nepal from August 17 to 19. During his visit, Nepal's President Ramchandra Paudel conferred upon him the rank of Honorary General of the Nepal Army. The visit aimed to strengthen defense ties between the two nations.
